profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in C#, Visual Basic, Microsoft Visual Studio, Databases, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, SQLLite, MongoDB, Java, Javascript, HTML and CSS. Strong engineering professional with a Certified: Introduction to ASP.NET focused in Computer Programming from Passaic County Community College and a Bachelor's Degree in Computer System Engineering (GPA 3.41). positions.title: Damage Prevention Inspection (DPI) - Field Supervisor
positions.description: In this role, I lead/manage 2 teams of 6-12 Damage Prevention Inspectors (DPI). This service is provided to the Gas Utility Companies with one team in Orange and Rockland County and another team in Westchester County both in New York State. My 2 teams inspect sites to ensure compliance with NYS Code Rule 753 regarding the protection of underground facilities.  Through an automated ticket management system, we review all NYS stakeout ticket requests, select high risk tickets per criteria defined by the facility operator (e.g., utilities within 4 ft. of the excavation), visit sites where excavating is being conducted to inspect and ensure Code Rule compliance is being followed, and provide our customers with weekly & YTD reports including recommendations from our findings.
positions.insights: Skills: Supervisory Skills · Live Meeting · Ticketing Systems · Performance Improvement · Supervisory Management · GPS System Monitoring · Recruiting · Job Coaching · Trainer · Site Supervision · Process Quality Improvement · Reports and Documentations · Fleet Operations · Fleet Maintenance

positions.description: This role represents our client, Intel®, by showcasing their latest core processing hardware and system enhancing technologies to store customers. Intel Promoter is responsible for executing retail sales strategies to promote the Intel brand. projects.description: Users can easily search for the perfect happy hour spot based on specific criteria like music genre, events, hours, deals, types of bars (such as sports bars, wine bar, tiki bar or dive bar), and we will also highlight the key features and categories of each bar.
